integrity: An explicit tree pair, independently computed probability distributions, exact expectation difference, and a finite exhaustive census are included; priority outside inspected literature remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Refutes KC monotonicity for random-order greedy maximal independent sets on trees, not the established path-minimum theorem. The minimum-order nine claim rests on exhaustive finite exact-rational enumeration and an explicitly supplied verifier. No general characterization of violating trees or independent priority assessment is claimed.
title: The smallest KC-tree shift that decreases random-greedy independence
